spans.s: वि—फ mfn. without the sound or letter फ, TāṇḍBr.
वि—फल See s.v.
mf(आ)n. bearing no fruit (as a tree), Kāv.; VarBṛS.
fruitless, useless, ineffectual, futile, vain, idle, Yājñ.; Hariv. &c.
having no testicles, R.
Pandanus Odoratissimus, L.
वि—फाण्ट mf(आ)n. decocted or distilled with (comp.), Gobh.

वि-√ फल् (only pf. -पफाल, 3. pl. -फेलिरे, v.l. -पेचिरे), to burst or split asunder, MBh.;
to bear or produce fruit, become fruitful, Ragh. (C.), xvii, 52.
वि-फल—ता f. fruitlessness, uselessness, unprofitableness, Kāv.; Pañcat.
वि-फल—त्व n. fruitlessness, uselessness, unprofitableness, Kāv.; Pañcat.
वि-फल—प्रेरण mfn. flung in vain, Hit.
वि-फल—श्रम mfn. exerting one's self in vain (-त्व n.), Rājat.
वि-फल—श्रम—त्व n.
वि-फ˚लारम्भ mfn. one whose efforts are vain or idle, Yājñ.
वि-फ˚लाश mfn. one whose hopes are disappointed, Hariv. (v.l. निष्फल्˚).
Nom. P. ˚यति, to render fruitless, frustrate, disappoint, prevent any one (gen.) from (inf.), Mudr.
in comp. for वि-फल.
विफली—करण n. making fruitless, frustrating, foiling, defeating, W.
doing anything in vain, ib.

विफली—√ कृ P. Ā. -करोति, -कुरुते, to make fruitless or useless, frustrate, thwart, foil, Inscr.; Kāv.;
to emasculate, R.
विफली—कृत mfn. rendered fruitless, frustrated, MBh.; Hariv.; R.
done in vain, W. (˚त-यत्न mfn. making fruitless efforts, MW.)
विफली—कृत-यत्न mfn., making fruitless efforts, MW.
विफली—भविष्णु mfn. becoming or become useless or unprofitable (-ता f. -त्व n.), Kāv.
विफली—भविष्णु—ता f.
विफली—भविष्णु—त्व n.
विफली—√ भू P. -भवति, to become useless, be unprofitable, Kāv.; Pañcat.
विफली—भूत mfn. become useless, R.
abundant, plentiful, KātyŚr. (? w.r. for वि-फल्क).
